entities.summary: Rolands Šmits is a Latvian professional basketball player for Anadolu Efes of the Turkish Basketbol Süper Ligi and the EuroLeague. At a height of 2.08 m, and a weight of 107 kg, he primarily plays at the power forward position, but can also play as small ball center.
